source: SYNTHETIC: a unit built to exercise the code, with three speeds, keyboard switching and every consent on. What the reference unit (FWB15CTV with FWECSA, slave 1, behind mbusd) showed on 2026-10-29 is under observed; the rest is from the manual's defaults. The reference unit as probed on 2026-10-30 is fwecsa_capture.json, and differs where this file assumed: four speeds, the board probe, every consent off, switching on water temperature.
